note: activity bar -- renders: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run and Debug, Extensions, Accounts, Settings (fixed VS Code view switcher icons and bottom toolbar buttons)
top menu bar -- renders: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help (fixed VS Code menu labels)
editor tab toolbar -- renders: Split Editor, More actions (fixed VS Code editor controls)

status bar -- renders fixed labels (Notifications, Forwarded Ports, Screen Reader Mode) and computed values (language mode, EOL, encoding, indentation, selection, problem counts); no user-authored prose
editor tab close button -- renders: Close (fixed VS Code control); the file name in the tab label stays masked
